name: Archmage Ansirem Runeweaver
summary: Archmage Ansirem Runeweaver is a senior human wizard and a ruling member of Dalaran's Council of Six. Having survived the Scourge's destruction of Dalaran in the Third War, he oversees Kirin Tor operations from the Violet Citadel as Dalaran is rebuilt. Though dedicated to the rebuilding of his city, he also maintains discreet interests abroad—including a willful daughter who ran off to Booty Bay to become a pirate.

sections.title: A Pillar of the Kirin Tor
sections.body: A veteran mage who helped defend Dalaran across decades, Ansirem Runeweaver sits on the Council of Six, the ruling magocracy of the Kirin Tor. He survived the devastation when Arthas Menethil and the Scourge marched upon the city and Archimonde was summoned. In the wake of Dalaran's fall, Ansirem has aided the efforts to rebuild the arcane city, whose protective shield was lifted early, and now works from the Violet Citadel.

sections.title: Far-Flung Interests
sections.body: Despite his scholarly duties and stern wizardly demeanor, Ansirem possesses personal ties far beyond the Alterac Mountains. His willful daughter, Catelyn, ran off to Booty Bay to become a pirate, taking with her an ancient troll dagger he had found while researching in Stranglethorn. He has also dealt with Baron Revilgaz there. He has also engaged in arcane studies involving troll antiquities and maintains diplomatic conduits across distant realms.

faq.answer: He is an accomplished human wizard and one of the six ruling archmages on the Kirin Tor's Council of Six. He has spent decades defending Dalaran and now oversees operations surrounding the reconstructed city and its arcane perimeter.

His willful daughter, Catelyn, ran off to Booty Bay to become a pirate, and she is known there as Catelyn the Blade. Ansirem had given her an ancient troll dagger he found while researching in Stranglethorn, and she took it with her.

faq.q: What is his role in Dalaran?
faq.answer: Ansirem serves as a key Kirin Tor presence in the Violet Citadel, coordinating research, magical defense, and communication with allies while the city is rebuilt after the destruction wrought during the Third War.

faq.q: Did Ansirem fight in the Third War?
faq.answer: Yes. Ansirem has helped defend Dalaran for decades, and he lived through the Scourge's siege of the city, when Arthas guarded Kel'Thuzad's summoning of Archimonde. He survived its destruction and now helps rebuild it.

angles.text: Ansirem is a revered member of the Council of Six, making him an enduring authority on disciplined arcane study.
As a Kirin Tor leader based in Lordaeron, Ansirem remains aligned with Alliance interests as human spellcasters struggle to reclaim their lands from Scourge remnants.
